Prelaunch website notice · 22 November 2026

About this website

Hello Customer is a product being developed under SaralKaro. This notice describes this prelaunch website, not the future application. The app’s detailed data practices, legal operator, processors, retention terms and privacy request channels must be confirmed before account registration opens.

Forms and interactive previews

The enquiry form processes what you type in your browser to prepare a message. It does not transmit form entries to Hello Customer, create a business account, upload customer contacts or enrol you in a waitlist. Entries are not saved in cookies or browser storage. Campaign previews use fictional sample content.

Hosting and external sites

Loading pages requires a connection to the hosting service, which can process technical request information such as an IP address. This website does not implement analytics, advertising trackers or third-party AI calls. If you open SaralKaro or another external website, that website’s own practices apply.

Your choices

You can clear a form by reloading or closing this page. Copying a prepared message uses your device’s clipboard after you select Copy. Information you subsequently share with SaralKaro is handled through the channel you choose. Do not include customer contact lists, passwords or sensitive personal information in an enquiry.

App privacy details before launch

The application’s account information, contact processing, messaging data, AI handling, provider details, retention periods and rights process will be described separately before those services become available. Dedicated privacy contact information and legal operator details have not yet been supplied for this website.
